subject: Mathematics
title: Theory of Binary Relations
quickSummary: A binary relation R is any subset of A × B. Total relations = 2^(mn). Inverse relation R^(-1) swaps domain and range.
summary: Master the anatomy of binary relations, domain, codomain, range, total counting of relations, and the inverse relation R^(-1).

conceptBreakdown.title: 2. Binary Relations, Domain, Range, and Codomain

summaryBox.title: Relation Anatomy
summaryBox.takeaway: R ⊆ A × B. Dom(R) ⊆ A, Rng(R) ⊆ B (Codomain). Total relations from A to B = 2^(|A||B|).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
ANATOMY OF A BINARY RELATION
                                   │
         ┌─────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐
         ▼                         ▼                         ▼
   DOMAIN, Dom(R)            RANGE, Rng(R)             CODOMAIN
   Set of all 1st elements   Set of all 2nd elements   The entire target set B.
   Dom(R) ⊆ A                Rng(R) ⊆ B                Notice: Rng(R) ⊆ B.
conceptBreakdown.content:
Let $A$ and $B$ be two non-empty sets. A **Binary Relation** $R$ from $A$ to $B$ is any arbitrary subset of the Cartesian product $A \times B$:
$$\mathbf{R \subseteq A \times B}$$
If $(a, b) \in R$, we write $a \, R \, b$ ($a$ is related to $b$ by $R$).

- **Domain ($	ext{Dom}(R)$)**: The set of all first coordinates of elements in $R$:
  $$\text{Dom}(R) = \{a \in A \mid \exists b \in B, (a, b) \in R\} \subseteq A$$
- **Range ($	ext{Rng}(R)$)**: The set of all second coordinates of elements in $R$:
  $$\text{Rng}(R) = \{b \in B \mid \exists a \in A, (a, b) \in R\} \subseteq B$$
- **Codomain**: The entire destination set $B$. Note that $\text{Rng}(R) \subseteq B$.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 2.1 Total Relations & Inverse Relation R⁻¹
conceptBreakdown.title: 2.1 Total Relations & Inverse Relation R⁻¹
conceptBreakdown.content:
### Total Number of Relations
If $|A| = m$ and $|B| = n$, then $|A \times B| = mn$. Since any subset of $A \times B$ is a valid relation, the total number of distinct relations from $A$ to $B$ equals the cardinality of the power set $\mathcal{P}(A \times B)$:
$$\mathbf{\text{Total Relations from } A \text{ to } B = 2^{|A \times B|} = 2^{mn}}$$
- **Non-Empty Relations**: $2^{mn} - 1$.

### Inverse Relation ($R^{-1}$)
Let $R \subseteq A \times B$ be a relation from $A$ to $B$. The **Inverse Relation** $R^{-1} \subseteq B \times A$ is defined as:
$$\mathbf{R^{-1} = \{(b, a) \in B \times A \mid (a, b) \in R\}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{Dom}(R^{-1}) = \text{Rng}(R) \quad \text{and} \quad \text{Rng}(R^{-1}) = \text{Dom}(R)}$$
